page_title: OSA 1-2 BAR | Osasuna v Barcelona 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+256' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Jagoba Arrasate (Osasuna) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+12' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+6' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+1' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) for a tough tackle.
90+1' Xavi prepares a substitution. Andreas Christensen is replaced by Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Robert Lewandowski is given a rest as he is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
85' 1 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Aitor Fernandez to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
85' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is sent off! Several teammates attempts to argue with the referee, but the decision has been made - it's beyond the point of no return.
84' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Alejandro Catena (Osasuna): it’s upheld, he has to go!

84' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna), but referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
83' The main referee, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is given a yellow card for dissent.
82' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!

81' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Barcelona! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
80' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) replacing Jesus Areso.
80' The game has come to an end for Oriol Romeu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joao Felix (Barcelona).
79' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Aitor Fernandez comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' 1 - 1 Fabulous goal. Chimy Avila (Osasuna) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a snap shot from edge of the box which flies into the back of the net off the left post.
74' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
73' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is intercepted by Aitor Fernandez.
72' Pablo Ibanez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
71' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Aitor Fernandez, who pulls off a stunning save!
68' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is flagged for offside.
68' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
67' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
62' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
62' Substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz makes way for Chimy Avila (Osasuna).
62' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Raul and he is replaced by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
61' It is time for a substitution. Kike Barja (Osasuna) is on for Ruben Garcia.
61' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Xavi decides to make a substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
59' Sergi Roberto goes off the pitch and Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) comes on.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) commits a foul and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias immediately signals a free kick.
54' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Gavi (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' The linesman raises his flag. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
49' Gavi (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
45+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
44' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Barcelona earn a corner.
42' Great touch by Jules Kounde (Barcelona) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
41' What was Jesus Areso (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
41' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

39' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for an infringement. Osasuna have been awarded a free kick.
38' The corner by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
38' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Now Barcelona have a corner.
36' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
33' A yellow card for a tackle by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
31' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and it's Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
27' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Osasuna.
26' A neat pass is well received by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
24' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
22' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends the corner into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen intercepts it and averts the threat.
22' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
19' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
18' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
16' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a foul.
13' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight and sees a foul from Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
11' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the left post.
10' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
7' Gavi (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a precise pass into the box, but Robert Lewandowski loses the one-on-one with the defender.
2' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) squanders a big chance. He takes a rebound inside the box and smashes the ball against the right post!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
